content.title: Does Asymmetric Cost Behaviour Affect Investors’ Heterogeneous Beliefs? Evidence from Egypt
content.abstract: Objectives This research aims to examine how asymmetric cost behaviour affects investors’ heterogeneous beliefs, with a particular focus on different cost components, based on evidence from Egyptian listed firms. Material and Methods The analysis is based on a sample of 71 non-financial firms listed on the Egyptian stock market over the period 2014-2023.
